Package httyd.model.skill

Interface PassiveSkill

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractPassive, Passives.Aura, Passives.Conductor, Passives.CritResist, Passives.DamageReduction, Passives.DamageUp, Passives.DebuffImmunity, Passives.DefStack, Passives.DodgeUp, Passives.FasterAttack, Passives.FlatBonus, Passives.LazySlumber, Passives.LowHpDefense, Passives.NeverDodged, Passives.NoPassive, Passives.PoisonSignature, Passives.ReflectAttack, Passives.ReflectDamage, Passives.SparksJet, Passives.SurviveOnce, Passives.TypelessCrit
public interface PassiveSkill
Strategy interface for the unique passive ability of a dragon. All hooks have neutral default implementations so a concrete passive only overrides what it needs.
